verdict.rationale: Devin publishes a documented public API (devin-docs-8) with dedicated API reference docs, including advanced features like creating sessions on behalf of other users (devin-docs-9), and the docs site itself hosts a large API documentation section (devin-probe-1). Missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s) and independent third-party corroboration of API usage.
